title: Trent's Last Case
description: A mystery game based on the classic novel 'Trent's Last Case' by E.C. Bentley, where players must uncover the truth behind the murder of the financier Abhay Vikrant at his estate, Kiara Vinita.
intro_narrative: Between what matters and what seems to matter, how should the world we know judge wisely? When the scheming, indomitable brain of Abhay Vikrant was scattered by a shot from an unknown hand, that world lost nothing worth a single tear. But when the news of his end came, it seemed to those living in the great vortices of business as if the earth too shuddered under a blow. The financier's body was found near a shed in the grounds of Kiara Vinita, his estate near Bishopsbridge. The mystery deepens as the household and the authorities struggle to piece together the events of that fateful night.

required_evidence: Marks on Vikrant's wrists indicating a struggle
Fingerprints on the glass bowl and window in Mrs. Vikrant's room
Footprints in the gravel outside the French window
Arvind's revolver found with traces of recent use
Vikrant's shoes showing signs of being worn by someone else
required_motive: Jealousy and suspicion of an affair between Aditya Vikrant and Kavita Arvind
Financial manipulation and revenge by disgruntled parties

phases.name: Arrival and Initial Investigation
phases.objective: Explore Kiara Vinita and its immediate surroundings, gather initial clues, and interview key characters present at the estate.

phases.name: Deepening the Mystery
phases.objective: Uncover more clues about Vikrant's last hours, explore additional locations, and interview more characters to piece together the events leading to the murder.

phases.name: Confrontation and Revelation
phases.objective: Confront suspects with evidence, unlock final locations, and gather the last pieces of the puzzle to identify the culprit.
unlocked_locations: Gardener's shed in Kiara Vinita grounds

phases.name: Resolution
phases.objective: Compile all evidence, motives, and testimonies to solve the mystery and present the findings.
